ValidationRule.description: When attempting to Close the Case (Status) and Commission Outcome on Application Form is null
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( SC_Record_Type_Formula__c="Sales Support", ISPICKVAL(Type, "Switcher Statement Review"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISBLANK(SC_CommissionOutcome__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must select a Commission Outcome on the corresponding Application Form to close this Case
